result.detail: The sidereal zodiac (lahiri) is not in the calc entry in this version; @zodiacs/engine/vedic gives sidereal longitudes on this ayanamsa.
Gravitational light deflection is not modelled in this version.
The Sun is the heliocentric origin.
The Earth is offered heliocentric or barycentric only.
North Node is a point of the Moon's geocentric orbit; only the geocentric center is offered.
Mean Node has no distance, so no cartesian position.
The instant's UT1 or TT is outside 1800-01-01T00:00:00.000Z to 2200-01-01T00:00:00.000Z, where the engine's positions have been compared with an independent ephemeris.

angles.label: measured
angles.basis: largest difference over the conformance suite's L2 vectors of the ascendant, midheaven, Vertex and East Point, whose arbiter is ERFA with each system's definition

cusps.label: measured
cusps.basis: largest difference over the conformance suite's L2 cusp vectors, thirteen systems, whose arbiter is ERFA with each system's definition

timing.label: estimated
timing.basis: the bisection bracket, step / 2^24, on the engine's own longitudes; the ephemeris's error over the body's speed adds to it
